# Screens

Derived from `routes/web.ts`, controller `this.inertia(...)` calls, and page components under `resources/js/pages/` — those files are the source of truth, not this document.

Page references are attributed to the controller action whose body makes the call, so a page lists only the routes of the action that renders it. A page referenced outside any action keeps a row with an empty Routes cell.

## Pages (6)

| Page | Props | Routes |
|------|-------|--------|
| auth/Login | { email?: string errors?: ValidationErrors<'email' \| 'password'> } | GET /login → LoginController.show |
| drive/Index | { folder: null breadcrumbs: Crumb[] folders: FolderSummary[] images?: ImageItem[] } | GET /files → DriveController.index |
| drive/Recent | { images: ImageSummary[] } | GET /recent → DriveController.recent |
| drive/Starred | { folders: { id: number, name: string }[] images: ImageSummary[] } | GET /starred → DriveController.starred |
| drive/Trash | { folders: { id: number, name: string }[] images: { id: number, name: string, starred: boolean }[] } | GET /trash → DriveController.trash |
| profile/Edit | { profile: { name: string; email: string } errors?: ValidationErrors<'name' \| 'email' \| 'password' \| 'currentPassword'> status?: string } | GET /profile → ProfileController.edit, PUT /profile → ProfileController.update |
